chemical_life_science_product_family.label: Chemical / life-science product family
chemical_life_science_product_family.value: Chlor alkali and vinyls (chlorine, caustic soda, bleach, hydrochloric acid), epoxy materials, chlorinated organics; Winchester ammunition

specialty_commodity_positioning.label: Specialty / commodity positioning
specialty_commodity_positioning.value: Largely commodity, integrated bulk chemicals (chlorine, caustic) with some more differentiated epoxy products and niche ingredients

formulation_synthesis_complexity.label: Formulation / synthesis complexity
formulation_synthesis_complexity.value: Large-scale integrated standardized production; epoxy derivatives need more downstream synthesis

product_specific_regulatory_route.label: Product-specific regulatory route
product_specific_regulatory_route.value: Chemical regulation such as TSCA and REACH; ammunition subject to firearms-related rules

notes: R&D intensity and patent dependence are not in the evidence; regulatory route comes from general knowledge.
